_about: Experiment 3 harness (second pilot batch): what the command loop runs with. Read by agentic/scripts/serve_oracle.py --command-loop. Thresholds of the five-link judge are in exp3_thresholds.json, not here.

pp_box.task_text: Pick up the box from the table and put it on the shelf.
pp_box._dev_seeds: Development layouts only (Arena's own seeded reset of box and shelf). Set aside on 2026-11-26 for building the harness; they must not be in the valid layout set V of experiment 2.

sit_sofa._dev_seeds: As for pp_box: development only, never in V.

vision_navi.task_text: Walk to the target marked on the floor and stop with both feet inside it.
vision_navi._dev_seeds: Interface self-check (plan v3, section 2 item 7): if the loop fails here, nothing else is read. Development only, never an evaluation episode.

budgets._about: To be fixed by the team before the formal run. Arena's own step limit (run_oracle.py --steps, default 3000 = 60 s) ends the episode too.

limits._about: Ranges a command may ask for (kimodo_vla/agent/commands.py DEFAULT_LIMITS); a command outside them is refused and the commander asked again.

planner._about: kimodo_vla/agent/planner.py SETTINGS. wrist_feedback stays off: closing the wrist error with measurements is experiment 4's step 3. Walks and turns are closed-loop on the true root pose (walk_tolerance_m, turn_tolerance_deg, at most move_corrections extra moves).

avoid_rules._about: Per tracker: motions it does badly and how the planner routes around them (plan v3, section 2 item 4). A rule with max_m null is not applied. Frozen with the VLM configuration; the measured basis is experiment 2's command test, entries marked pending until it reports.

turn.rule: aim twice the yaw still to go (turn_gain 2)
turn.measured: exp3 smoke 2026-11-26: a +30 deg turn aimed exactly stalled at 17 deg after 10.6 s (reference stopped 3 deg short, tracker ~8 deg behind); with the gain a 180 deg turn took 12.6 s and ended 0.06 deg off

lean.measured: exp3 smoke: torso_pitch 15 deg reached 6-9 deg (reference 14.4)

sidestep.rule: longer sidesteps become turn + forward walk + turn back

backward.rule: longer backward walks become turn + forward walk + turn back
backward.status: pending experiment 2 (exp 2 of batch 1: backward 7/10 within 5 cm vs forward and side 15/15)

smoke.name: SmokeScript
smoke._about: One of every command type, to check the planner end to end and record the scene; not a task.

scripted.name: TaskScript
scripted._about: The acceptance test of the harness: a fixed rule per task computed from the ground-truth objects, no VLM.

scripted_feedback.name: TaskScript
scripted_feedback._about: As scripted, with the first batch's reach feedback (measured wrist shortfall added to the command, gain 0.7, at most 12 cm) switched on in the planner. Whether the formal baseline has it is a team decision: it closes part of link 3 inside the planner.

qwen._about: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, local (--vlm-model). Prompt: the prompt block of vlm-config.md.

gpt._about: Candidate only, not frozen: the model the first batch's pointing experiment used. Key: OPENAI_API_KEY in agentic/env.local.sh. One connectivity check at most without the user's go-ahead.

gemini._about: Candidate only, as gpt. Key: GEMINI_API_KEY in agentic/env.local.sh.
